newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian shipper CMB's earnings jump on exceptional items.
newsitem.headline: Belgian shipper CMB's earnings jump on exceptional items.

text.p: Belgian shipping group CMB NV said on Friday the sale of a seven percent stake in U.S. oil exploration firm Diamond Offshore Drilling boosted first-half earnings and would allow the group to pay an exceptional interim dividend.

CMB said consolidated net profit in the six months to June 30 jumped to 3.65 billion francs ($119.7 million) from 610 million in the year-earlier period. Consolidated pre-tax exceptional gains jumped to 2.89 billion from 56 million.

CMB's sale of its stake in Diamond Offshore Drilling gave it a 4.49 billion franc capital gain. It also had an exceptional gain of 368 million francs on the recovery of a non-performing loan. CMB would write off goodwill for 2.01 billion francs.
CMB plans to pay an exceptional interim net dividend of 200 Belgian francs to all shareholders as of October 4.

It said that the sale of its 20 percent stake in Bermuda-registered Pacific Basin Bulk Shipping to Malaysian transport firm Perkapalan Berhad would be finalised in September. CMB said in July that the sale would net it $50 million. ($ = 30.48 Belgian Francs)
